g.text: Current implementation • Electron + React + TypeScript • Control + Shift to ask, release to send

teacher-segment / lesson events reach the UI

store: false; timeouts; no automatic retries

Ordinary input clears marks, narration continues

Solid arrows: main request / event paths. Dashed arrow: optional web search. Provider responses return to their caller.
Local modules support the flow above. The user clicks in their own app; teachMe cannot control it. No selected-text capture or Realtime path.
Settings → preload course IPC → main → course.ts → OpenAI vector store. The folder and subfolders are uploaded; only metadata stays local.
Saved course ID reaches planLesson; the model decides whether to use file_search. Jev still owns screenshot and drawing decisions.
Changing folders replaces the index; Remove attempts remote cleanup. Existing cleanup failures can leave files in OpenAI.
